limitations: Small probe; not general prose quality or ATS acceptance.
Cost is unknown without a current billing rate; token usage is reported when provided.
Timeout/cancellation and malformed partial batches are tested offline; no deliberately expensive live failure loop.
42 authored factor combinations of 30 questions, not 1260 independent intents. After first evaluation these become a regression set.
Restricted closed-shadow forms stay in the overall workload denominator; their field values cannot be inspected.
The filler is loaded from the ZIP; read-only observers use byte-identical source modules served locally.
Local browser task latency is not human review time.
Providers are disabled here; zero cost does not estimate live cost.
No claim of real Workday/Keka acceptance or 90% human time saving.
